description: A sound: every parameter as a number from 0 to 1.

src.harm_mix.description: Level of the partial bank. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 1.0.

src.noise_mix.description: Level of the shaped noise. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.1.

src.grain_mix.description: Level of the grain cloud. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

src.tilt.description: Slope of partial levels. Lower is duller. Normalized 0 to 1; real range -24.0 to 6.0 dB/oct, neutral -6.0.

src.oddeven.description: Odd against even partials. Positive is hollow. Normalized 0 to 1; real range -1.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

src.stretch.description: Inharmonicity B in f_k = k f0 sqrt(1 + B k^2). Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 0.01, neutral 0.0.

src.jitter.description: Slow random detune of each partial. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 50.0 cents, neutral 0.0.

src.modal.description: Ratio table: 0 harmonic, 1 drumhead, 2 bar. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 2.0, neutral 0.0.

src.damp.description: How much faster high partials die than low ones. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

src.f1_freq.description: First formant centre. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 200.0 to 1200.0 Hz, neutral 600.0.

src.f1_gain.description: First formant boost. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 24.0 dB, neutral 0.0.

src.f2_freq.description: Second formant centre. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 700.0 to 3500.0 Hz, neutral 1500.0.

src.f2_gain.description: Second formant boost. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 24.0 dB, neutral 0.0.

grain.size.description: Grain length. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.01 to 0.5 s, neutral 0.08.

grain.density.description: Grains per second. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 1.0 to 100.0 1/s, neutral 20.0.

grain.pos.description: Read position in the source. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.5.

grain.spray.description: Random spread of the read position. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

grain.scatter.description: Random spread of grain timing. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

fold.amt.description: Wavefolder drive. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

fold.bias.description: Wavefolder offset. Adds even harmonics. Normalized 0 to 1; real range -1.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

clang.amt.description: Metallic phase and ring modulation. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

clang.ratio.description: Modulator frequency over f0. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.25 to 8.0, neutral 1.41.

comb.amt.description: Resonant comb mix. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

comb.tune.description: Comb pitch over f0. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.5 to 4.0, neutral 1.0.

comb.decay.description: Comb ring time. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.01 to 2.0 s, neutral 0.2.

smear.amt.description: Spectral blur (v1, not played). Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

smear.freeze.description: Spectral freeze (v1, not played). Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

crush.bits.description: Bit depth. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 2.0 to 16.0 bits, neutral 16.0.

crush.rate.description: Sample-and-hold rate. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 500.0 to 48000.0 Hz, neutral 48000.0.

tape.amt.description: Wow, flutter and dropouts. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

filt.cutoff.description: Filter cutoff. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 20.0 to 20000.0 Hz, neutral 20000.0.

filt.res.description: Filter resonance. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

filt.morph.description: Low-pass at 0, band-pass at 0.5, high-pass at 1. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

filt.track.description: How far the cutoff follows pitch. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

env.attack.description: Rise time. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.001 to 4.0 s, neutral 0.005.

env.hold.description: Time at full level after the attack. The minimum means none. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0005 to 2.0 s, neutral 0.0005.

env.decay.description: Fall time to the sustain level; ring time of a struck sound. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.005 to 8.0 s, neutral 0.3.

env.sustain.description: Level held while the note lasts. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.8.

env.release.description: Fade after the note ends. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.005 to 8.0 s, neutral 0.2.

env.noise_decay.description: Fall time of the noise, separate from the body. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.005 to 4.0 s, neutral 0.2.

env.pitch_amt.description: Pitch offset at the start of the note. Normalized 0 to 1; real range -24.0 to 48.0 semitones, neutral 0.0.

env.pitch_time.description: How fast the start pitch falls back. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.001 to 0.5 s, neutral 0.05.

strike.click.description: Start transient. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

strike.color.description: Pitch of the clicks. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 200.0 to 12000.0 Hz, neutral 3000.0.

strike.end_click.description: Closing transient. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

lfo1.rate.description: First LFO rate. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.05 to 20.0 Hz, neutral 5.0.

lfo1.to_pitch.description: First LFO to pitch. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 100.0 cents, neutral 0.0.

lfo1.to_filter.description: First LFO to cutoff. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 4.0 oct, neutral 0.0.

lfo1.to_level.description: First LFO to level. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

lfo2.rate.description: Second LFO rate. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.05 to 20.0 Hz, neutral 0.5.

lfo2.to_pitch.description: Second LFO to pitch. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 100.0 cents, neutral 0.0.

lfo2.to_filter.description: Second LFO to cutoff. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 4.0 oct, neutral 0.0.

lfo2.to_grain.description: Second LFO to grain position. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

chaos.rate.description: Speed of the random wander. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.1 to 30.0 Hz, neutral 2.0.

chaos.amt.description: Random wander of pitch, cutoff and level. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

delay.time.description: Echo time. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.01 to 2.0 s, neutral 0.375.

delay.fb.description: Echo feedback. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 0.95, neutral 0.35.

delay.shift.description: Pitch shift inside the echo loop. Normalized 0 to 1; real range -12.0 to 12.0 semitones, neutral 0.0.

delay.mix.description: Echo level. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

verb.size.description: Room size and tail length. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.5.

verb.damp.description: High-frequency loss in the tail. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.5.

verb.mix.description: Reverb level. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

verb.freeze.description: Holds the tail forever at 1. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 1.0, neutral 0.0.

width.description: Stereo width: 0 mono, 1 as is, 2 wide. Normalized 0 to 1; real range 0.0 to 2.0, neutral 1.0.

tone_bands.description: Partial levels by frequency band, the vowel shape. 16 numbers from 0 to 1 (low to high frequency, 80 Hz to 12 kHz); real range -30.0 to 30.0 dB, neutral 0.0.

noise_bands.description: Noise levels by frequency band. 16 numbers from 0 to 1 (low to high frequency, 80 Hz to 12 kHz); real range -30.0 to 30.0 dB, neutral 0.0.
